name: QQQ Trailing P/E: How Expensive Is the Nasdaq?
description: QQQ trailing P/E ratio from income_statement quarterly diluted_eps. TTM EPS = rolling 4-quarter sum, ffilled to daily. P/E = close / TTM EPS (null where EPS ≤ 0). Dot-com peak identified in Jan–Jun 2000 window. Era comparison table: Dot-Com Bubble, Post-Bubble Recovery, GFC, Post-GFC Bull, COVID & Recovery, Current (2023+).
source:
# ============================================================
# QQQ Trailing P/E Ratio — Full History with Dot-Com Comparison
# ============================================================
# TTM EPS from quarterly income_statement diluted_eps
# P/E = daily close / TTM EPS (null where EPS ≤ 0)
# Era-based statistics table + dot-com peak event marker

# --- Data ---
src = study_assets()
ts = index().value
close = src.c

# Quarterly diluted EPS from income_statement
inc = income_statement(period=BalanceSheetTimeframe.quarterly)
q_eps = inc.diluted_eps

# --- TTM EPS: rolling 4-quarter sum on sparse quarterly data ---
# Each quarterly print has one value; sum the last 4 prints
# Use valuewhen to reach back to the 4 most recent quarterly observations
eps_q0 = valuewhen(is_valid(q_eps), q_eps, occurrence=0)
eps_q1 = valuewhen(is_valid(q_eps), q_eps, occurrence=1)
eps_q2 = valuewhen(is_valid(q_eps), q_eps, occurrence=2)
eps_q3 = valuewhen(is_valid(q_eps), q_eps, occurrence=3)

# TTM = sum of 4 most recent quarters (already forward-filled by valuewhen)
ttm_eps_raw = eps_q0 + eps_q1 + eps_q2 + eps_q3

# Forward-fill to ensure daily coverage
ttm_eps = ffill(ttm_eps_raw)

# --- Trailing P/E ---
# Only valid where TTM EPS > 0
valid_eps = is_valid(ttm_eps) and ttm_eps > 0
trailing_pe = where(valid_eps, close / ttm_eps)

# --- Dot-Com Peak Detection (Jan 2000 – Jun 2000) ---
dotcom_start = Timestamp(value="2000-01-01")
dotcom_end = Timestamp(value="2000-06-30")
in_dotcom_window = ts >= dotcom_start and ts <= dotcom_end

# P/E within the dot-com window
pe_in_window = where(in_dotcom_window, trailing_pe)

# Find the max P/E in that window (expanding max on filtered series)
dotcom_peak_val = agg(pe_in_window, AggregationType.Max)

# Detect the bar where P/E equals the peak (first occurrence in window)
is_dotcom_peak = in_dotcom_window and is_valid(trailing_pe) and is_valid(dotcom_peak_val) and (trailing_pe >= dotcom_peak_val - 0.01) and (trailing_pe <= dotcom_peak_val + 0.01)

# Only fire once — on the first bar matching
bars_since_peak = barssince(is_dotcom_peak)
is_first_peak = is_dotcom_peak and (bars_since_peak == 0)

# Peak label
peak_label = where(is_first_peak, "Dot-Com Peak")

# --- Era Definitions ---
era1_start = Timestamp(value="1999-01-01")
era1_end = Timestamp(value="2002-09-30")
era2_start = Timestamp(value="2002-10-01")
era2_end = Timestamp(value="2007-06-30")
era3_start = Timestamp(value="2007-07-01")
era3_end = Timestamp(value="2009-06-30")
era4_start = Timestamp(value="2009-07-01")
era4_end = Timestamp(value="2019-12-31")
era5_start = Timestamp(value="2020-01-01")
era5_end = Timestamp(value="2022-12-31")
era6_start = Timestamp(value="2023-01-01")

# Assign era number (1-6) for grouping
era_num = conditional_select(
    ts >= era1_start and ts <= era1_end, 1.0,
    ts >= era2_start and ts <= era2_end, 2.0,
    ts >= era3_start and ts <= era3_end, 3.0,
    ts >= era4_start and ts <= era4_end, 4.0,
    ts >= era5_start and ts <= era5_end, 5.0,
    ts >= era6_start, 6.0,
    0.0 / 0.0)

# P/E filtered to valid eras only
pe_for_table = where(is_valid(era_num) and is_valid(trailing_pe), trailing_pe)
era_for_table = where(is_valid(era_num) and is_valid(trailing_pe), era_num)

# --- CHART 1: Trailing P/E Over Time ---
xy_lines(
    title="Is QQQ Expensive? Trailing P/E Since Inception",
    y_axis_label="Trailing P/E",
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    category="QQQ Valuation",
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name="Trailing P/E", color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    y_plot_bands=PlotBandSchema(bands=[
        PlotBand(from=0, to=20, color=Color.Green, opacity=0.08, label="Cheap"),
        PlotBand(from=40, to=200, color=Color.Red, opacity=0.08, label="Expensive")
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=25.0, title="Historical Avg Zone", color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash),
        ReferenceLine(value=80.0, title="Dot-Com Peak ~80x", color=Color.Red, dash_style=DashStyle.LongDash)
    ])
)(x_values=ts, y_values=trailing_pe)

# --- EVENT MARKER: Dot-Com Peak ---
event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title="Dot-Com Peak",
        icon=Icon.AlertTriangleIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title="Label", type=CardRenderType.TextFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.PrimaryBadge),
            ColumnSpec(title="Trailing P/E", dp=1, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Hero),
            ColumnSpec(title="QQQ Close", dp=2, type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Footer),
            ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ]
    )
)(peak_label, trailing_pe, close, is_first_peak)

# --- TABLE: Era Statistics ---
summary_table(
    mode=TableMode.rowspec,
    category="QQQ Valuation",
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title="QQQ Trailing P/E by Market Era",
        col_headers=["Dot-Com Bubble", "Post-Bubble", "GFC", "Post-GFC Bull", "COVID Era", "Current (2023+)"],
        rows=[
            RowSpec(name="Avg P/E", agg=AggregationType.Mean,
                    type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=1),
            RowSpec(name="Median P/E", agg=AggregationType.Median,
                    type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=1),
            RowSpec(name="Max P/E", agg=AggregationType.Max,
                    type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=1),
            RowSpec(name="Min P/E", agg=AggregationType.Min,
                    type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=1),
            RowSpec(name="End P/E", agg=AggregationType.Last,
                    type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=1)
        ]
    )
)(pe_for_table, era_for_table)
